WITH TEMP AS (
    SELECT CIF_ID, BANK_ID, MAX(ENROLLMENT_DATE) MAX_ENROLLMENT_DATE, MAX(STATUS_DATE) MAX_STATUS_DATE, SOURCE_CODE FROM EDS.DIGITAL_ENROLLMENTS_FACT 
    WHERE CIF_ID  IN (SELECT CIF_ID FROM EDS.DIGITAL_ENROLLMENTS_FACT WHERE STD_STATUS IN ('Active','Enabled') GROUP BY CIF_ID)
    GROUP BY CIF_ID, BANK_ID, SOURCE_CODE
)

INSERT INTO 
(
	 CIF_ID
	,BANK_ID
	,RELATIONSHIPOPENINGDATE
	,MBK_USER_NAME
	,RIB_USER_NAME
	,D30_USER_NAME
	,ENROLLMENT_DATE
	,MBK_ENROLLMENT_FLG
	,RIB_ENROLLMENT_FLG
	,D30_ENROLLMENT_FLG
	,MBK_ENROLLMENT_DATE
	,RIB_ENROLLMENT_DATE
	,D30_ENROLLMENT_DATE
	,MBK_ENROLLMENT_STATUS
	,RIB_ENROLLMENT_STATUS
	,D30_ENROLLMENT_STATUS
	,MBK_ENROLLMENT_STATUS_DATE
	,RIB_ENROLLMENT_STATUS_DATE
	,D30_ENROLLMENT_STATUS_DATE
	,D30_SWITCHER
	,INSERT_DTTM
)

SELECT
 CIF_ID
,BANK_ID
,RELATIONSHIPOPENINGDATE AS RELATIONSHIPOPENINGDATE
,MAX(MBK_USER_NAME) AS MBK_USER_NAME
,MAX(RIB_USER_NAME) AS RIB_USER_NAME
,MAX(D30_USER_NAME) AS D30_USER_NAME
,CAST(MIN(ENROLLMENT_DATE) AS DATE) AS ENROLLMENT_DATE
,MAX(MBK_ENROLLMENT_FLG) AS MBK_ENROLLMENT_FLG
,MAX(RIB_ENROLLMENT_FLG) AS RIB_ENROLLMENT_FLG
,MAX(D30_ENROLLMENT_FLG) AS D30_ENROLLMENT_FLG
,MAX(MBK_ENROLLMENT_DATE) AS MBK_ENROLLMENT_DATE
,MAX(RIB_ENROLLMENT_DATE) AS RIB_ENROLLMENT_DATE
,MAX(D30_ENROLLMENT_DATE) AS D30_ENROLLMENT_DATE
,MAX(MBK_ENROLLMENT_STATUS) AS MBK_ENROLLMENT_STATUS
,MAX(RIB_ENROLLMENT_STATUS) AS RIB_ENROLLMENT_STATUS
,MAX(D30_ENROLLMENT_STATUS) AS D30_ENROLLMENT_STATUS
,MAX(MBK_ENROLLMENT_STATUS_DATE) AS MBK_ENROLLMENT_STATUS_DATE
,MAX(RIB_ENROLLMENT_STATUS_DATE) AS RIB_ENROLLMENT_STATUS_DATE
,MAX(D30_ENROLLMENT_STATUS_DATE) AS D30_ENROLLMENT_STATUS_DATE
,CASE WHEN GREATEST(MAX(CONVERT(DATE,MBK_ENROLLMENT_STATUS_DATE)),MAX(CONVERT(DATE,RIB_ENROLLMENT_STATUS_DATE))) IS NULL
    THEN 0
    ELSE
        CASE WHEN GREATEST(MAX(CONVERT(DATE,MBK_ENROLLMENT_STATUS_DATE)),MAX(CONVERT(DATE,RIB_ENROLLMENT_STATUS_DATE))) > MAX(CONVERT(DATE,ISNULL(D30_ENROLLMENT_STATUS_DATE,'1900-01-01')))
            THEN 0
            ELSE 1
        END
 END AS D30_SWITCHER
,CAST(SYSDATETIMEOFFSET() AT TIME ZONE 'Singapore Standard Time' AS datetime) AS INSERT_DTTM
FROM (
    /*=====MBK=====*/
    SELECT
         DEF.CIF_ID
        ,DEF.BANK_ID
        ,MIN(ECD.RELATIONSHIPOPENINGDATE) AS RELATIONSHIPOPENINGDATE
        ,DEF.USER_NAME AS MBK_USER_NAME
        ,NULL AS RIB_USER_NAME
        ,NULL AS D30_USER_NAME
        ,MIN(DEF.ENROLLMENT_DATE) AS ENROLLMENT_DATE
        ,CASE WHEN MIN(DEF.ENROLLMENT_DATE) IS NOT NULL THEN 1 ELSE 0 END AS MBK_ENROLLMENT_FLG
        ,0 AS RIB_ENROLLMENT_FLG
        ,0 AS D30_ENROLLMENT_FLG
        ,MIN(DEF.ENROLLMENT_DATE) AS MBK_ENROLLMENT_DATE
        ,NULL AS RIB_ENROLLMENT_DATE
        ,NULL AS D30_ENROLLMENT_DATE
        ,CASE WHEN DEF.ENROLLMENT_DATE = TMP.MAX_ENROLLMENT_DATE THEN DEF.STD_STATUS  ELSE NULL END AS MBK_ENROLLMENT_STATUS
        ,NULL AS RIB_ENROLLMENT_STATUS
        ,NULL AS D30_ENROLLMENT_STATUS
        ,TMP.MAX_STATUS_DATE AS MBK_ENROLLMENT_STATUS_DATE
        ,NULL AS RIB_ENROLLMENT_STATUS_DATE
        ,NULL AS D30_ENROLLMENT_STATUS_DATE
    FROM EDS.DIGITAL_ENROLLMENTS_FACT DEF
    JOIN TEMP TMP ON DEF.CIF_ID = TMP.CIF_ID AND DEF.BANK_ID = TMP.BANK_ID AND DEF.SOURCE_CODE = TMP.SOURCE_CODE AND COALESCE(TMP.MAX_STATUS_DATE,TMP.MAX_ENROLLMENT_DATE) = COALESCE(DEF.STATUS_DATE,DEF.ENROLLMENT_DATE)
    LEFT JOIN EDS.CUSTOMER_DIM ECD ON DEF.CIF_ID = ECD.ORGKEY AND ECD.BANK_ID = DEF.BANK_ID AND ECD.ISLATEST = 1
    WHERE DEF.SOURCE_CODE = 'MBK'
    AND DEF.SCD_END_DATE = '9999-12-31'
    --AND DEF.STD_STATUS  IN ('Active','Enabled')
    GROUP BY DEF.CIF_ID, DEF.BANK_ID, DEF.STD_STATUS, DEF.SOURCE_CODE, TMP.MAX_ENROLLMENT_DATE, TMP.MAX_STATUS_DATE, DEF.ENROLLMENT_DATE, DEF.USER_NAME
    
    UNION ALL
    /*=====RIB=====*/
    SELECT
         DEF.CIF_ID
        ,DEF.BANK_ID
        ,MIN(ECD.RELATIONSHIPOPENINGDATE) AS RELATIONSHIPOPENINGDATE
        ,NULL AS MBK_USER_NAME
        ,DEF.USER_NAME AS RIB_USER_NAME
        ,NULL AS D30_USER_NAME
        ,MIN(DEF.ENROLLMENT_DATE) AS ENROLLMENT_DATE
        ,0 AS MBK_ENROLLMENT_FLG
        ,CASE WHEN MIN(DEF.ENROLLMENT_DATE) IS NOT NULL THEN 1 ELSE 0 END AS RIB_ENROLLMENT_FLG
        ,0 AS D30_ENROLLMENT_FLG
        ,NULL AS MBK_ENROLLMENT_DATE
        ,MIN(DEF.ENROLLMENT_DATE) AS RIB_ENROLLMENT_DATE
        ,NULL AS D30_ENROLLMENT_DATE
        ,NULL AS MBK_ENROLLMENT_STATUS
        ,CASE WHEN DEF.ENROLLMENT_DATE = TMP.MAX_ENROLLMENT_DATE THEN DEF.STD_STATUS  ELSE NULL END RIB_ENROLLMENT_STATUS
        ,NULL AS D30_ENROLLMENT_STATUS
        ,NULL AS MBK_ENROLLMENT_STATUS_DATE
        ,TMP.MAX_STATUS_DATE  AS RIB_ENROLLMENT_STATUS_DATE
        ,NULL AS D30_ENROLLMENT_STATUS_DATE
    FROM EDS.DIGITAL_ENROLLMENTS_FACT DEF
    JOIN TEMP TMP ON DEF.CIF_ID = TMP.CIF_ID AND DEF.BANK_ID = TMP.BANK_ID AND DEF.SOURCE_CODE = TMP.SOURCE_CODE AND COALESCE(TMP.MAX_STATUS_DATE,TMP.MAX_ENROLLMENT_DATE) = COALESCE(DEF.STATUS_DATE,DEF.ENROLLMENT_DATE)
    LEFT JOIN EDS.CUSTOMER_DIM ECD ON DEF.CIF_ID = ECD.ORGKEY AND ECD.BANK_ID = DEF.BANK_ID AND ECD.ISLATEST = 1
    WHERE DEF.SOURCE_CODE = 'RIB'
    AND DEF.SCD_END_DATE = '9999-12-31'
    --AND DEF.STD_STATUS  IN ('Active','Enabled')
    GROUP BY DEF.CIF_ID, DEF.BANK_ID, DEF.STD_STATUS, DEF.SOURCE_CODE, TMP.MAX_ENROLLMENT_DATE, TMP.MAX_STATUS_DATE, DEF.ENROLLMENT_DATE, DEF.USER_NAME
    
    UNION ALL
    /*=====D30=====*/
    SELECT
         DEF.CIF_ID
        ,DEF.BANK_ID
        ,MIN(ECD.RELATIONSHIPOPENINGDATE) AS RELATIONSHIPOPENINGDATE
        ,NULL AS MBK_USER_NAME
        ,NULL AS RIB_USER_NAME
        ,DEF.USER_NAME AS D30_USER_NAME
        ,MIN(DEF.ENROLLMENT_DATE) AS ENROLLMENT_DATE
        ,0 AS MBK_ENROLLMENT_FLG
        ,0 AS RIB_ENROLLMENT_FLG
        ,CASE WHEN MIN(DEF.ENROLLMENT_DATE) IS NOT NULL THEN 1 ELSE 0 END AS D30_ENROLLMENT_FLG
        ,NULL AS MBK_ENROLLMENT_DATE
        ,NULL AS RIB_ENROLLMENT_DATE
        ,MIN(DEF.ENROLLMENT_DATE) AS D30_ENROLLMENT_DATE
        ,NULL AS MBK_ENROLLMENT_STATUS
        ,NULL AS RIB_ENROLLMENT_STATUS
        ,CASE WHEN DEF.ENROLLMENT_DATE = TMP.MAX_ENROLLMENT_DATE THEN DEF.STD_STATUS  ELSE NULL END AS D30_ENROLLMENT_STATUS
        ,NULL AS MBK_ENROLLMENT_STATUS_DATE
        ,NULL AS RIB_ENROLLMENT_STATUS_DATE
        ,TMP.MAX_STATUS_DATE AS D30_ENROLLMENT_STATUS_DATE
    FROM EDS.DIGITAL_ENROLLMENTS_FACT DEF
    JOIN TEMP TMP ON DEF.CIF_ID = TMP.CIF_ID AND DEF.BANK_ID = TMP.BANK_ID  AND DEF.SOURCE_CODE = TMP.SOURCE_CODE AND COALESCE(TMP.MAX_STATUS_DATE,TMP.MAX_ENROLLMENT_DATE) = COALESCE(DEF.STATUS_DATE,DEF.ENROLLMENT_DATE)
    LEFT JOIN EDS.CUSTOMER_DIM ECD ON DEF.CIF_ID = ECD.ORGKEY AND ECD.BANK_ID = DEF.BANK_ID AND ECD.ISLATEST = 1
    WHERE DEF.SOURCE_CODE = 'D30'
    --AND DEF.SCD_END_DATE = '9999-12-31'
    --AND DEF.STD_STATUS  IN ('Active','Enabled')
    GROUP BY DEF.CIF_ID, DEF.BANK_ID, DEF.STD_STATUS, DEF.SOURCE_CODE, TMP.MAX_ENROLLMENT_DATE, TMP.MAX_STATUS_DATE, DEF.ENROLLMENT_DATE, DEF.USER_NAME

) A

GROUP BY  CIF_ID, BANK_ID, RELATIONSHIPOPENINGDATE
